claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach maps data vectors to a space where linear separation is possible, providing an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping.
RKS has been explored for natural language processing tasks and has shown effectiveness in achieving high accuracy in offensive language detection.
The RKS method improves classification results by mapping features to higher dimensions, enhancing their linear separability.
